thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT - hosted kvcache pool reporting repeated OOMs and eviction storms. multiple nodes affected. incident page: https://incidents.redwood/4065432100

emi (oncall): seeing KV cache size spike to ~1.8TB on hosted-runtime-42, host mem ~98%, OOMs started at 4065432100. continuous-batching window sizes exploded.

raj (sre): paging in. any idea what rolled recently?

cs-rep: we've got 3 customer tickets — timeouts and 503s, started ~10:02 UTC (approx). customers report degraded service.

maria-ml: metrics show batching optimizer roll (2026-09-12) increased prefix prefetching heuristics. batch window distribution shifted right; long prompts amplified KV growth.

sam (engineer): likely regression from auto prefetch change + continuous batching. quick mitigation: disable prefetch & continuous batching, force eviction.

emi (oncall): proposed hotfix steps (quick):
1) disable prefetch on hosted-runtime routes
2) set kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.6
3) disable continuous_batching boolean
4) canary restart and monitor

Commands to run now:
```
# disable prefetch + continuous batching on route
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routes/hosted-runtime/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"enable_prefetch": false, "continuous_batching": false}'

# force cache eviction on pool
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/kvcache/evict -d 'pool=hosted-runtime'

# rolling restart canary workers
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/hosted-runtime-canary
```

deploy-bot: started rollout for hosted-runtime-canary -> image hosted-runtime:2026-09-12-hotpatch

raj (sre): running config change now. also throttling long-context requests at edge to reduce ingress while we stabilize:
```
# limit long prompts >16k tokens to 5r/s
adminctl routes update --route hosted-runtime --limit-long-prompts 5
```

emi (oncall): initial customer impact estimate: ~2.4% of requests returned 500/503 between 10:00-10:30 UTC. top affected customers: cust-zen, acct-42. SLA window impacted ~30m.

cs-rep: drafted customer notif, waiting to confirm stability before send. no credits decided yet. :pencil:

maria-ml: monitoring shows canaries dropping memory pressure after config change; KV size trending down. host-level OOMs stopped on canaries ~8m after hotfix.

sam (engineer): canary looks clean, starting gradual rollout to 30% in 10m. will watch for regressions.

deploy-bot: rollout schedule: 10% -> 30% -> 70% with 5m intervals; will pause on errors.

emi (oncall): handoff: I'm heading into a meeting at 11:15 UTC. handing to raj for overnight triage. please keep the incident doc updated: https://incidents.redwood/4065432100

raj (sre): ack, taking lead. immediate next actions: capture heap dumps from affected nodes, collect recent commit hashes for batching optimizer, run targeted replays against prefetch toggle to reproduce. will coordinate RCA.

ops-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by raj (sre). ENG-ML and ENG-RUNTIME paged. :white_check_mark:

sam (engineer): summary of temp flags applied: enable_prefetch=false, continuous_batching=false, eviction_threshold=0.6 (applied to hosted-runtime routes/pools).

maria-ml: i'll run replay with long prompt traces to verify whether optimizer change increases KV insertion rate for long contexts; will share test cases and results in incident doc.

cs-rep: notification sent to affected customers at 10:58 UTC, copied runbook and CS playbook.

raj (sre): last update before handover: canaries healthy, memory down ~70% from peak, no new OOMs in last 8m. continuing rollout and collection for RCA.

emi (oncall): thanks everyone. handing complete. :v:
